terms.definition: A straight path with one endpoint extending forever in one direction.
terms.function: Models beams of light and one-way paths.
terms.whereItIs: The stroke from dot to arrowhead.
terms.whyItMatters: Rays are the arms of every angle.

terms.definition: The starting point of a ray, named first.
terms.function: Ray AB starts at endpoint A.
terms.whereItIs: The solid dot at the start.
terms.whyItMatters: The endpoint gives the ray its identity.

terms.definition: The mark at a ray's open end showing it never stops.
terms.whereItIs: The arrow triangle at the open end.
terms.whyItMatters: One arrowhead is what separates a ray from a segment.

terms.definition: The shared endpoint where two rays form an angle.
terms.function: The corner point of an angle.
terms.whereItIs: Point A where both rays meet.
terms.whyItMatters: The vertex is the center around which angles are measured.
